name: Daniella M.
headline: From kitchen crew to kitchen supervisor
summary: Meal prep, safe food handling, teamwork. She built on skills she already used inside.

steps.title: CA Food Handler Card
steps.action: Build on the food-safety skills you have.

advice: I wrote down what I actually did: prep meals, keep food safe, help the crew. That gave me words for my first interview. Start with what you know, then ask what you need next.

name: Tasha
headline: From cleaning crew to nursing assistant
summary: Careful routines and looking out for others were skills she could name.

steps.title: Check CNA licensing rules
steps.action: Ask the CA board how a record affects certification before you pay for training.

advice: I called the licensing board before I signed up for anything. Knowing my options first meant I didn't waste money.
licensing_note: A record may affect licensing. Check with the CA board before paying for training.

name: Renee
headline: From laundry crew to forklift lead
summary: Sorting, tracking supplies, and keeping a busy team organized counted as experience.

steps.title: Forklift certification
steps.action: Build on the sorting and safety habits you already have.

advice: I checked the bus route before every application. A job I could actually get to mattered more than the highest wage.
